parts.text: I add new drones to the fleet and set up charging pads at our sites as part of keeping our drones and charging equipment in working order. Our company has a few dozen charging pads at our own sites, and several connector types are in use that are not interchangeable. Each drone has a home site, and our drones come in several models from different manufacturers with different capabilities for carrying loads, flying distance, sensors, and charging connectors.
